results.hypothesis: The feature fires on the preposition "about" when it introduces the topic or subject matter of a noun like "messages about X."
positive_probes: I received several emails about the merger.
She archived notes about ancient astronomy.
They published articles about climate migration.
We found messages about schedule changes.
He kept a folder about tax rules.
distractor_probes: I told him about the merger yesterday.
She worries about ancient astronomy too much.
They argued about climate migration policies.

positive_probes: The server status message reports healthy replication.
Storage health alerts indicate the array is degraded.

Monitoring alert reports node and disk health issues.
distractor_probes: Please restart the server after installing updates.
The storage team replaced failed drives yesterday.
Users received messages about the scheduled maintenance window.
